Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building age, size, classrooms, specialized spaces, and detailed site plans (Parts 3.1, 3.2). Robust condition assessment covering HVAC, roofing, plumbing, electrical, lighting, and security systems with modernization and replacement plans (Parts 3.1.1-3.1.8, 3.2). Connects condition data to long-term capital planning and educational priorities.

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Includes detailed enrollment projections with methodology referencing Davis Demographics study (Part 3.3). Provides capacity utilization data by site and classroom, with plans for new construction, modernization, and portable classroom replacement linked to enrollment trends (Parts 3.1, 3.2, 3.3). Explicit strategies for closures, expansions, and adaptive uses are described.

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with clear integration of district mission and instructional priorities (District Design 2022, Parts 1 and 2). Detailed educational specifications for Modern Learning Studios and Innovation Centers connect facility projects directly to educational goals including collaboration, technology integration, and flexible learning environments (Parts 2.1, 2.2).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Plan provides data and analysis on outdoor spaces with strategies for improvement such as shade structures, outdoor classrooms, and landscaping at multiple campuses (Parts 3.1, 3.2). Includes some districtwide references to outdoor learning and green space enhancements but lacks comprehensive districtwide data on green surface area or detailed climate resilience framing.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Minimal mention of climate risks or resilience strategies. No comprehensive climate risk assessment or detailed mitigation strategies related to climate impacts are evident in the plan.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Mentions energy efficiency projects such as solar panel installation options and energy efficient exterior lighting (Part 3). However, lacks detailed energy use data, comprehensive energy resilience strategies, or explicit references to state requirements like Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed cost estimates for all projects with escalation assumptions and soft costs included (Part 4). Provides a clear prioritization framework and multiple funding strategies including bonds and state programs. Aligns financial capacity with educational priorities and long-term sustainability.
